# ghost/qonvert

Qonvert (F-Droid): convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, duodecimal and hexadecimal and see fractions, continued fractions and Roman numerals. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/qonvert
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/qonvert open_converter --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/qonvert convert --device <serial> --param value=<value>
ghost skill run ghost/qonvert get_result --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/qonvert clear_input --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_converter`: Open the number base converter
- `convert`: Convert 255 from decimal to hex
- `get_result`: What does the converter show?
- `clear_input`: Clear the number base converter
